thread:
Alex: Quick heads-up — need 2x LGTM on PR #7124 (hotfix: quant-shard race) before 11:30 PT cutoff. Tests are green locally; flaky e2e popping intermittently. If you can take second signoff please say so. @sam @maria
Maria: Looking now — quick q: does this change the default token cache TTL? I didn't see a config bump.
Alex: No TTL change, just race guard around kv cache flush. Linked the snippet: ```diff
- flush_async()
+ flush_locked()
```
Maria: OK makes sense. Will do a quick pass.
Kevin: CI showed one flake on integration 3/10. Rerun might clear it, but flagging in case it's env. :eyes: 
Rachel: I can take the second signoff if Maria is tied up. Will skim and run smoke locally. :ok_hand: 
ci-bot: rerun tests triggered by Rachel (build 7124.3)
Sam: heads-up I'm OOO until 12:15 PT but can jump in if still needed after that.
Maria: quick comment left on a logging nit, otherwise LGTM from me. :thumbsup: 
Rachel: ran smoke, looks stable. LGTM. Adding comment about test coverage but not blocking.
Alex: Thanks all — merging at cutoff unless rollback requested. I'll watch metrics for 30m post-merge. :rocket: 
Sam: back and gave final pass — LGTM as well, good to go.
Alex: Merged and started rollout. Notifying infra channel and will post rollback plan if anything odd shows up. Thanks everyone! :tada:
